reading.body:
Strategic Datasphere has no confirmed operator, no working website, and no published power specifications, making it unsuitable for analysis of AI infrastructure despite sitting at a real Alpharetta office address.

The facility is tagged in OpenStreetMap at a legitimate location in a north Atlanta technology corridor where data center and network operators do work. Research exhausted multiple paths, including domain resolution, business registration databases, and public records, without finding evidence that any company currently operates under this name at the address. The absence of a discoverable web presence for a company this specifically named, combined with no third-party verification, distinguishes this from merely obscure operators that leave traces in public records or DNS systems.

Georgia has four data centers with published power specifications totaling 66.3 megawatts. This facility cannot be ranked among them or compared to state capacity because it publishes no power figure and remains unconfirmed as operating. Thirty-three other facilities are mapped in Georgia through OpenStreetMap, the majority of which also publish no capacity data, making statewide grid impact difficult to assess.

Without operator confirmation, published specifications, or third-party verification, this listing cannot ground claims about AI infrastructure scaling or power constraints. It remains tagged as unconfirmed pending evidence of current operation.
